metaDescription: Order custom Bulwark lanyards and badges for your team. Durable, professional IDs with your logo. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Bulwark lanyards and badges offer a rugged, professional look for industrial and safety-focused teams. Unlike standard nylon lanyards, Bulwark options feature heavy-duty breakaway clasps and reinforced stitching, making them ideal for warehouse or field use. Decorate with your company logo using screen printing or woven labels for high-visibility branding that holds up to daily wear.
heroAltText: Custom Bulwark lanyards and badges with breakaway clasps and printed logo, ideal for safety teams
